result.document_summary: New Jersey P.L. 2025, c.405, an enacted act capping residential rental application fees at $50 (CPI-adjusted annually) and setting penalties, exemptions and rulemaking.
result.notes: Effective date computed: approved January 20, 2026; takes effect on the first day of the fourth month next following enactment, i.e., 2026-05-01. The annual CPI adjustment begins January 1 of the year next following enactment (2027). Section 1(c) exempts one- and two-family dwellings and real estate licensees who are not the landlord.

rules.title: Residential rental application fee capped at $50
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property that exceeds $50, adjusted annually for CPI increases. Violators face penalties of up to $500 (first), $750 (second) and $1,000 (subsequent offenses), and the amount wrongfully charged is remitted to the applicant.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to residential rental properties for dwelling purposes, except one- and two-family dwellings and non-landlord real estate licensees.
